predecessors.name: Ukraine
predecessors.text: the part of Donetsk Oblast held by the separatists: Donetsk, Horlivka and the eastern districts

successors.name: Russian Federation
successors.text: the DPR as annexed by Russia on 30 September 2022 (the DPR's claimed borders; about 55% of Donetsk Oblast by June 2022)

ledger.x: 7 April 2014: separatists proclaim the Donetsk People's Republic.
12 April 2014: the war in Donbas begins.
5 July 2014: Ukraine retakes Sloviansk and Kramatorsk.
February 2015: Debaltseve falls to the separatists.
By June 2022: Russian and DPR forces hold about 55% of Donetsk Oblast.
30 September 2022: the republic ends in annexation; the fighting for the rest of Donetsk Oblast continues as Russia against Ukraine.
30 September 2022: Russia announces the annexation of the DPR.

wars.name: War in Donbas
wars.outcome: Ukraine retook Mariupol (13 June 2014) and Sloviansk and Kramatorsk (5 July 2014); Minsk II was agreed on 12 February 2015 and the front stayed static until Russia recognised the DPR and LPR on 21 February 2022 and invaded on 24 February.

wars.name: Russian invasion of Ukraine
wars.outcome: Russia and the DPR held about 55% of Donetsk Oblast by June 2022; Russia announced the annexation of the DPR on 30 September 2022.

certainty.note: A line of contact, static from 2015 to February 2022; the pages give no coordinates.
